title: Mini Petite Party Eye & Cheek Makeup Gift Set
descriptionHtml:
✓ Clean at Sephora✓ Cruelty-Free
What it is: A limited-edition mini set of four festive favorites for a complete eye-to-cheek party look, featuring three new shades.

Highlighted Ingredients:
- Jojoba Seed Oil (Baby Cheeks Blush Stick): Improves hydration and strengthens the skin’s moisture barrier.
- Emollient Oil Blend (Lit Up Highlight Stick): Helps with smooth application and softens skin; boosts glassy radiance.
- Carnauba & Candelilla Wax Blend (Eye Want You Mascara): Ultra-creamy texture for maximum build.
- Shea Butter (Eye Love You Eye Pencil): Provides smooth application.

Ingredient Callouts: These products are cruelty-free.

What Else You Need to Know: Get party-ready in minutes with this curated set of four minis in limited-editio
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
Baby Cheeks Blush Stick:
-Apply directly to cheeks, working in a small oval motion, blending up and outward as you go. -Dab onto lips for a monochromatic look and juicy pop of color.

Lit Up Highlight Stick:
-Glide on high points of face, Cupid’s bow, and center of bottom lip for dimension, and on the top of cheekbones up to the temples to accentuate and lift.
-Wear alone for effortless radiance, as a lip balm for juicy hydration, or layered over foundation.

Eye Love You Eye Pencil:
-Glide the sharpened tip along the lash line for skip-free definition.
-Smudge into the lashes for subtle, lived-in definition.

Eye Want You Mascara:
-Beginning at your lash line, wiggle the wand from side-to-side to catch every lash with each swipe.
-Each swipe helps build thickness and volume.
Ingredients+
-Jojoba Seed Oil (Baby Cheeks Blush Stick): Improves hydration and strengthens the skin’s moisture barrier.
-Emollient Oil Blend (Lit Up Highlight Stick): Helps with smooth application and softens skin; boosts glassy radiance.
-Carnauba & Candelilla Wax Blend (Eye Want You Mascara): Ultra-creamy texture for maximum build.
-Shea Butter (Eye Love You Eye Pencil): Provides smooth application.

Petite Baby Cheeks Blush Stick in Poppy:
Simmondsia Chinensis (Jojoba) Seed Oil, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Dicalcium Phosphate, Synthetic Wax, Dicaprylyl Ether, Caprylyl Caprylate/Caprate, Kaolin, Mica, Saccharomyces Ferment, Stearalkonium Bentonite, Rubus Idaeus (Raspberry) Leaf Extract, Rubus Idaeus Leaf Cell Culture, Lauroyl Lysine, Propylene Carbonate, Polyhydroxystearic Acid, Pentaerythrityl Tetra-Di-T-Butyl Hydroxyhydrocinnamate, Tocopherol, Titanium Dioxide (CI 77891), Iron Oxides (CI 77491), Iron Oxides (CI 77492), Iron Oxides (CI 77499), Red 7 (CI 15850), Red 28 Lake (CI 45410), Yellow 5 Lake (CI 19140), Blue 1 Lake (CI 42090).

Petite Lit Up Highlight Stick in Toast:
Diisostearyl Malate, Octyldodecanol, Tridecyl Trimellitate, Synthetic Wax, Dimer Dilinoleyl Dimer Dilinoleate, Mica, Synthetic Fluorphlogopite, Glyceryl Behenate/Eicosadioate, Synthetic Beeswax, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Vitis Vinifera (Grape) Fruit Extract, Pentaerythrityl Tetra-Di-T-Butyl Hydroxyhydrocinnamate, Dicalcium Phosphate, Silica, Tin Oxide, Calcium Sodium Borosilicate, Calcium Titanium Borosilicate, Calcium Aluminum Borosilicate, Alumina, Titanium Dioxide (CI 77891), Iron Oxides (CI 77491), Iron Oxides (CI 77492), Iron Oxides (CI 77499), Red 6 (CI 15850), Red 7 (CI 15850), Red 27 (CI 45410), Red 28 Lake (CI 45410), Yellow 5 Lake (CI 19140), Blue 1 Lake (CI 42090).

Eye Love You Eye Pencil in Cendre:
Hydrogenated Jojoba Oil, Iron Oxides (CI 77499), Mica, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Simmondsia Chinensis (Jojoba) Seed Oil, Hydrogenated Vegetable Oil, Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter, Canola Oil, Iron Oxides (CI 77491), Copernicia Cerifera Cera/ Copernicia Cerifera (Carnauba) Wax/Cire de Carnauba, Iron Oxides (CI 77492), Glyceryl Caprylate, Titanium Dioxide (CI 77891), Synthetic Fluorphlogopite, Candelilla Cera/Euphorbia Cerifera (Candelilla) Wax/Cire de Candelilla, Tocopherol, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Oil, Ascorbyl Palmitate.

Petite Eye Want You Mascara in Clean Black:
Aqua/Water/Eau, Candelilla Cera/Euphorbia Cerifera (Candelilla) Wax/Cire de Candelilla, Iron Oxides (CI 77499), Polyglyceryl-6 Distearate, Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter, Dimer Dilinoleyl Dimer Dilinoleate, Glycerin, Cera Carnauba/Copernicia Cerifera (Carnauba) Wax/Cire de Carnauba, Polyglyceryl-10 Myristate, Cetyl Alcohol, Glyceryl Caprylate, Leuconostoc/Radish Root Ferment Filtrate, Xanthan Gum, Arginine, Phenethyl Alcohol.

The list of ingredients is subject to change. Please consult the packaging of the product purchased.
